description: Checks that every uploaded file is complete and submits the space for processing. The account is emailed when the space is ready.

notes.description: Optional notes for processing, such as what the capture is or how the tour should go.

output.description: What to build: "splat", a 3DGS (3D Gaussian splat) visitors move through freely (the default for photos, video and 360 captures); "tour", a guided tour of 360 panoramas (the default for E57 scans); or "auto" to use those defaults. Set it only when the person asks for one.

space_id.description: The space ID (12 hexadecimal characters) from create_space or space_status.

name: finish_upload
title: Finish upload
